title: bitcmp
summary: Complement the bits of integer-valued input.

gpu_support.notes: Documented gpuArray input is uint8, uint16, or uint32 and uses exact owner-aware fallback with resident output.

description: `C = bitcmp(A)` complements every bit in the storage class of `A`. The optional `assumedtype` supplies the width and signedness for integer-valued double input.
behaviors: All eight native integer classes preserve class and shape.
Integer-valued double input requires an assumed integer type.
Supported gpuArray forms return resident output; unsupported classes and assumedtype GPU calls are rejected in MATLAB-compatible mode.
